A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' was employed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He was a guard on the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] climbed up the walls of the sail barge after eliminating guards from the second skiff, this Weequay opened his window attempting to shoot down Skywalker, however the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] instead grabbed him and threw him out of the ''Khetanna''.

==Behind the scenes==
Although thrown out of the ''Khetanna'' by Skywalker during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], this Weequay is never actually shown being devoured by the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]]. Instead the film immediately cuts to [[Kithaba/Legends|Kithaba]] being swallowed. ''[[The Great God Quay: The Tale of Barada and the Weequays]]'' simply states that this Weequay was thrown to the desert floor.
